$description: DDS native-only foundations — values a touch platform needs that the web has no use for (control heights, touch targets, list stagger, screen shift, bar heights). Read only by the Android generator (scripts/generate-android-tokens.mjs); web artifacts never see this file. Numbers are dp (text is sp).

easing.$description: travel: a slow start for something that was standing still (a logo leaving the splash), so it does not appear to jump.

stagger.$description: List items appear step apart; only the first `limit` indexes are delayed so a long list does not trickle.

splash.$description: hold: pause on the finished mark before it travels. keep-limit: longest the system splash may be held, measured from the first ready frame.

back.$description: double-press: two presses of the system back closer together than this ask to leave the app instead of going back twice.

control.$description: Button heights (minimums). sm is the visible height; its touch area is still touch.min.

screen.$description: gutter below the breakpoint width, gutter-wide at or above it; block-gap between stacked blocks.

large-text.$description: The app-offered large text mode: the same eight styles, stepped up. It stacks with the system font scale (values are sp).
